id: Pedang sihir ciptaan Aula Pemanggil Akras, khusus digunakan Pemanggil. Ditempa tukang paling jago di Randall, didesain untuk memberikan keseimbangan sifat menyerang dan bertahan. Ringan, dan mudah dimanuver sehingga merupakan senjata sempurna untuk pemula, terbukti handal dalam misi berbahaya. Kemampuan mengembangkan keahlian melalui pemakaian terus menerus menjadikannya senjata yang dicintai banyak pejuang berpengalaman.
name: MST_SU_ARM_10_DESC
desc: A magical sword created by the Akras Summoners' Hall specifically for the use of Summoners. Forged by the most capable craftsmen of Randall, it was designed to provide a balance between its offensive and defensive properties. Its light weight and easy maneuverability makes it the perfect weapon for novices, proving especially reliable in dangerous missions. Furthermore, its ability to develop new skills through continuous usage makes it a beloved weapon for many experienced warriors as well.

id: Kapak perang ditemukan di makam Michele, di Bectas. Telah berabad-abad dan dirawat makhluk mekanis yang menjaganya waktu itu. Terkonfirmasi memiliki kemampuan sihir yang mencegahnya kehilangan daya serang. Sangat berat sehingga susah dibawa, dan sangat diinginkan sebagai pertahanan. Meski demikian, ada yang tertarik karena kekuatan destruktifnya yang besar.
name: MST_SU_ARM_30_DESC
desc: A war axe discovered in Michele's Sepulcher, located in Bectas. This axe has seen the centuries go by, and was well cared for by the mechanical creatures that guarded it during that time. It has also been confirmed to have magical abilities that prevent it from losing its attack power. Its great weight makes it difficult to wield, and leaves a lot to be desired as far as defense. Nevertheless, there are those who find themselves attracted to its overwhelming destructive power regardless.

id: Pistol yang ditemukan di Jalan Bawah Nol. Berisi perlindungan ilahi sehingga bisa salah satu tangan dan pemula bisa bergerak lincah. Kecepatan moncong bertambah sesuai pengalaman menggunakan senjata, juga daya benturan dan akurasi. Mulai naik karena peningkatan seni bela diri berbasis pistol. Ini menggabungkan manuver seperti memantul dari tembok dan batu, gerajan yang mengalahkan segerombolan musuh selagi bertempur jarak dekat.
name: MST_SU_ARM_40_DESC
desc: Pistols discovered on Subzero Road. Imbued with divine protection that allows use with either hand and allows for novices to move skillfully. Their muzzle velocity also increases in accordance with experience using the weapons, as do impact force and accuracy. As such, they have given rise to an increase in gun-based martial arts. These incorporate maneuvers such as ricochets off of walls and rocks, and moves that defeat entire groups of enemies while seemingly entering close combat.

id: Pedang hebat yang ditemukan terbungkus batu di Sarang Serigala Mistis di Vilanciel. Tadinya dipikir sudah dipakai Kaisar Bariura saat pertama kali menghadapi serigala ilahi. Memakainya serasa menyerang dengan segumpal logam, dan bukan memotong, dan susah dibawa oleh orang biasa. Klaimnya, tak ada yang bisa menahan satu serangan dengan pedang ini dan kekuatan untuk memakainya tidaklah berlebihan.
name: MST_SU_ARM_50_DESC
desc: A great sword found embedded in a stone in the Mystical Wolf's Lair in Vilanciel. It is thought to have been used when the Emperor of Bariura first faced the divine wolf. Using it is more like striking with a lump of metal than cutting, and even carrying it is a struggle for normal people. However, claims that nothing can withstand a single blow from a warrior with this blade and the skill and strength to use it are not exaggerated.

id: Sabit hebat indah ini ditemukan di Penjara Beast Ilahi. Desain ningrat yang menggangu ini sepertinya merujuk pada sepasang saudari. Dongeng tentang dua saudari ini memakai sabit setan yang tertinggal bermandikan darah adalah salah satu yang paling mewakili dalam sejarah Kekaisaran Bariura. Sangat mudah digunakan meski dari bentuknya yang tidak biasa, bilah sihirnya cukup tajam untuk menembus kekosongan itu sendiri. Pasti mengirim musuh Pemanggil yang mengganggu untuk mendapatkan ganjarannya.
name: MST_SU_ARM_60_DESC
desc: This beautiful great scythe was found in the Divine Beast's Prison, and its unsettling, noble design almost seems to convey its reverence for a certain pair of sisters. The tales of these two sisters using a demonic scythe who left battlefields drenched in blood are among the most representative in the Bariura Empire's history. It is unbelievably easy to use despite what one would imagine from its unorthodox shape, and its magical blade is sharp enough to cut through nothingness itself. It is sure to send the Summoner's more bothersome foes to their just rewards.

id: Cambuk yang dibuat dari kulit naga buas dari dunia lain. Tak hanya bisa digunakan untuk menyerang musuh, tapi ujung lancipnya juga bisa memberikan luka fatal pada semua target. Fleksibilitasnya membuat penggunanya mudah mengenai target dalam jarak jauh sekalipun. Meskipun tiap Pemanggil punya gaya bertarung yang berbeda, ini bukanlah senjata yang gampang untuk pemula, dan karena itu hanya direkomendasikan untuk Pemanggil yang mampu dan berpengalaman.
name: MST_SU_ARM_70_DESC
desc: A whip made from the hide of a furious dragon from another world. Not only can it be used to strike foes, but its sharp tip can simultaneously inflict fatal damage upon any target. Its great flexibility also allows the wielder to hit any target regardless of the distance between the two. Although Summoners all have different styles of fighting, this is not really the easiest weapon for novices to use, and thus it is only recommended for capable and experienced Summoners.

Meskipun tiap Pemanggil punya gaya bertarung yang berbeda, ini bukanlah senjata yang gampang untuk pemula, dan karena itu hanya direkomendasikan untuk Pemanggil yang mampu dan berpengalaman.
raw.pt: A whip made from the hide of a furious dragon from another world. Not only can it be used to strike foes, but its sharp tip can simultaneously inflict fatal damage upon any target. Its great flexibility also allows the wielder to hit any target regardless of the distance between the two. Although Summoners all have different styles of fighting, this is not really the easiest weapon for novices to use, and thus it is only recommended for capable and experienced Summoners.
raw.th: แส้ที่สร้างขึ้นจากมังกรดุร้ายที่ซ่อนตัวอยู่ในโลกอื่น ไม่เพียงจะใช้ฟาดศัตรู แต่ความแหลมคมของมันยังทำให้เกิดความเสียหายที่รุนแรงต่อทุกเป้าหมาย ความยืดหยุ่นของมันทำให้ผู้ใช้สามารถโจมตีคู่ต่อสู้ได้โดยไม่ต้องคำนึงเรื่องระยะห่าง แม้ว่าซัมมอนเนอร์ทุกคนต่างมีสไตล์การต่อสู้ที่ต่างกัน แต่นี่ก็ไม่ใช่อาวุธที่ผู้ฝึกหัดจะใช้ได้ง่ายๆ และเหมาะสำหรับซัมมอนเนอร์ผู้มีประสบการณ์แล้วเท่านั้น

id: Busur yang dibuat oleh perajin yang singgah di Elgaia dari dunia lain. Punya jangkauan yang jauh karena bahan pembuatan kompositnya. Meskipun indah, panahnya punya kemampuan untuk menghancurkan musuh luar dalam. Mereka juga mengambil energi dari musuh yang terkena, menambah energi pemanahnya dalam perang.
name: MST_SU_ARM_80_DESC
desc: A bow made by a craftsman visiting Elgaia from another world. It has great range due to its composite construction. Though beautiful, its arrows have the terrifying ability destroy enemies from the inside out. They also devour the energy of any foes they hit, boosting the archer's energy in the process during battle.

id: Pedang ganda dibuat dari bahan dunia lain. Logam ini mempunya energi magis, dan mereka meninggalkan bayangan setelah diayunkan. Menyerang sebelum bayangan itu hilang akan menambah dalam luka musuh. Banyak prajurit yang berusaha menggunakan pedang ini karena itu, tapi hanya beberapa yang bisa menguasainya karena dibutuhkan kekuatan yang luar biasa untuk menggunakannya.
name: MST_SU_ARM_90_DESC
desc: Twin blades made from otherworldly ore. The metal holds magical energy, and they leave afterimages when swung. Striking before the images fade will deepen foes' wounds. Many warriors have sought to use these blades due to that advantage, however few have been able to master them due to the massive amounts of strength required to wield them.

id: Pedang yang dibuat dengan baik oleh seorang ahli besi ternama. Pedang ini adalah prototipe dari karya ahli besi nantinya yang dibuat untuk membunuh Rubah Mistis, dan menambah serangan penggunanya. Banyak ahli pedang yang telah menggunakannya, tapi sampai saat ini pedang ini tetap tajam seperti hari dia dibuat.
name: MST_SU_ARM_100_DESC
desc: A blade masterfully made by a skilled smith. This blade is a prototype of later works the smith made to slay the Mystical Fox, and enhances its wielder's attacks. Many swordmasters have wielded this blade over time, but even to this day it retains the precise sharp edge it had on the day it was forged.

id: Tongkat, tadinya milik santa terkenal zaman kuno. Santa bepergian keliling negeri, menyembuhkan banyak orang, menawarkan dukungan melawan invasi Tentara Dewa. Meski pejuang di pihaknya berusaha keras melindunginya, ia mengorbankan nyawa setelah menginfusi tongkat tercinta dengan kekuatan terakhirnya. Yang mewarisi tongkat disebut santa sendiri, dan dikuilkan berabad-abad sebagai simbol imannya.
name: MST_SU_ARM_110_DESC
desc: A staff that once belonged to a renowned saint from ancient times. The saint traveled all over the land healing countless people, and offering her support against the invading forces of the God Army as well. Although the warriors on her side did everything they could to protect her, she ultimately gave her life for the cause after infusing her beloved staff with the last of her power. Those who inherited the staff revered it as the saint herself, and enshrined it for centuries as a symbol of her faith.

raw.th: ไม้เท้าที่เคยเป็นของนักบุญที่มีชื่อเสียงมาตั้งแต่สมัยโบราณ นักบุญเดินทางไปทั่วแผ่นดินรักษาคนนับไม่ถ้วนและให้การสนับสนุนของเธอต่อต้านกองกำลังรุกรานของกองทัพเทพเจ้าเช่นกัน แม้ว่านับรบทั้งหลายในฝั่งของเธอจะทำทุกอย่างที่พวกเขาทำได้เพื่อปกป้องเธอ, ท้ายที่สุดเธอก็ได้สละชีวิตเพื่ออุดมการหลังจากผสานไม้เท้าสุดรักของเธอเข้ากับหลังสุดท้ายของตน บรรดาผู้ที่สืบทอดไม้เท้านั้นต่างเคารพนับถือมันราวกับตัวนักบุญเอง, และประดิษฐานไว้เป็นเวลาหลายศตวรรษเพื่อเป็นสัญลักษณ์แห่งความเชื่อของเธอ

id: Set pedang pendek ditemukan di kuil dunia lain. Investigasi kuil menunjukkan senjata ini barang upacara suci yang dipakai dalam ritual tarian festival. Penarinya juga ahli pedang, mampu membuat musuh kewalahan dengan serbuan membingungkan. Kemahiran penarilah yang awalnya membuat pedang dipuja-puja. Ini membuat penari mengembangkan teknik mirip tarian indah namun mematikan.
name: MST_SU_ARM_120_DESC
desc: A set of short swords discovered in an otherworldly temple. An investigation of the temple has revealed that these weapons were sacred ceremonial items used in festival dance rites. The dancers for these performances were also masters of these blades, able to overwhelm enemies with an instantaneous flurry of strikes. Indeed, it was the dancers' great skill that originally led to the blades becoming objects of worship. In turn, this allowed the dancers to develop countless beautiful yet deadly dance-like techniques.

id: Palu masif, dibuat untuk menghancurkan boneka yang amat Tersihir dalam sekali serbu. Penciptanya awalnya menekankan kemampuan destruktif ini, merugikan sifat lainnya, sehingga terlalu besar dan berat untuk dibawa-bawa. Setelah diperbaiki banyak pandai besi, kini palu terbentuk dan berukuran untuk manusia. Masih memukul kuat sehingga meremukkan zirah boneka bermantra dengan mudah, dan terlihat amat mengintimidasi sehingga musuh akan kabur begitu melihatnya.
name: MST_SU_ARM_130_DESC
desc: A massive hammer made to destroy even immense enchanted puppets in a single strike. Its creators originally emphasized this destructive power to the detriment of all other traits, making it both too large and heavy to carry with ease. However, after improvements from numerous master smiths, it is now shaped and sized for human use. It still strikes with a force that can crush an enchanted puppet's armor with ease, and looks so intimidating that some foes will flee at the mere sight of it.

id: Pedang panjang ditemukan di puing boneka termantra di Makam Hancur di Rokkzalm. Awalnya seperti potongan kecil logam, tapi mulai bersinar dan berubah bentuk saat diambil Pemanggil tertentu. Pemanggil lalu bermandikan cahaya, lalu dihiasi baju gemerlap. Riset lalu mengungkap bahwa pedang terbuat dari logam tak dikenal yang menciptakan manifestasi fisik dari keberanian pembawanya. Sangat jarang pemegang pedang ini akan mati selama dia memegang senjatanya. setidaknya, selama dia masih berani...
name: MST_SU_ARM_140_DESC
desc: A longsword discovered in the remains of an enchanted puppet at the Demolished Tomb in Rokkzalm. It initially seemed to be a simple piece of scrap metal, but began to glow and change form when a certain Summoner grasped it. The Summoner was first enshrouded in light, then bedecked in resplendent attire. Later research revealed that the sword is made of an unknown metal which creates physical manifestations of the wielder's courage. It seems unlikely that a wielder of this blade can fall, so long as he or she maintains a grip on the weapon. At least, so long as the wielder's courage holds out, that is...

id: Kapak perang yang ditemukan tersegel di tanah Ishgria, rumah para setan kuat. Kekuatannya bertambah sesuai semangat juang pemegangnya. Para sarjana percaya, pada kekuatan penuh, kapak cukup kuat untuk membunuh setan dan dewa. Legenda dari Ishgria berkata, kapak tersegel bertahun-tahun. Keberadaannya disamarkan setan yang takut kapak akan mengganggu keseimbangan kekuatan di Ishgria dan mengundang perang yang tak diperlukan.
name: MST_SU_ARM_150_DESC
desc: A battleaxe found sealed in the land of Ishgria, a world home to throngs of powerful demons. Its power increases relative to its wielder's fighting spirit, and scholars believe that at full power it can strike with enough force to readily slay both gods and demons alike. Legends from Ishgria tell us that the axe was sealed away for many years, its existence concealed by a demon who feared it might disrupt the balance of power in Ishgria and invite more needless battles.

raw.th: ขวานต่อสู้ ถูกปิดผนึกไว้ในดินแดนแห่ง อิชเกรีย ซึ่งเป็นบ้านของฝูงปีศาจที่ทรงพลัง พลังของมันเพิ่มมากขึ้นสัมพันธ์กับวิญญาณของนักต่อสู้และนักวิชาการเชื่อว่าพลังเต็มที่สามารถโจมตีด้วยแรงพอที่จะฆ่าทั้งเทพและปีศาจได้อย่างง่ายดาย ตำนานจาก อิชเกรีย บอกเราว่าขวานถูกปิดผนึกไว้เป็นเวลาหลายปีการดำรงอยู่ของมันซ่อนไว้โดยปีศาจที่กลัวว่ามันอาจทำลายความสมดุลของอำนาจใน อิชเกรีย และเชิญการต่อสู้ที่ไม่มีความจำเป็นมากขึ้น

id: Asalnya adalah Segel Api, salah satu dari 8 "Harta Karun Suci". Dicuri oleh Sol Badguy dari Ordo Kudus Ksatria Suci dan dimodifikasi. Selain berupa senjata tumpul dan senjata api, dia mampu memperbesar kekuatan api pemegangnya. Senjata yang dimiliki Pemanggil adalah salinan suka-suka buatan Sol, terbuat dari suku cadang. Kalah dibanding aslinya, tetapi kekuatan apinya tak terlampaui senjata biasa.
name: MST_SU_ARM_8010_DESC
desc: Originally the Fireseal, one of the eight "Sacred Treasures". It was stolen by Sol Badguy from the Sacred Order of Holy Knights and modified. In addition to being both a blunt weapon and a firearm, it is able to amplify its wielder's flame powers. The weapon possessed by the Summoner is but a copy created from spare parts by Sol on a whim. It is inferior to the original, but boasts considerable firepower that is unsurpassed by normal weapons.

raw.th: เดิมทีเป็นผนึกไฟ หนึ่งในแปด "สมับัติศักดิ์สิทธิ์" มันถูกขโมยโดย โซล แบ้ดกาย จาก ภาคี ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ของอัศวินศักดิ์สิทธิ์และดัดแปลงมัน นอกเหนือจากการเป็นอาวุธทุบตีและอาวุธปืนแล้วยังสามารถขยายอำนาจเปลวไฟของผู้ครอบครองได้อีกด้วย อาวุธที่ถูกครอบครองโดย ซัมมอนเนอร์ เป็นเพียงของจำลองที่สร้างขึ้นจากชิ้นส่วนอะไหล่โดย โซล มันด้อยกว่าของดั้งเดิม, แต่มีพลังในการยิงอย่างมากที่ไม่มีใครเทียบได้ด้วยอาวุธปกติ

id: Zaman dahulu, naga setan brutal muncul di dunia lain. Karena terganggu, para dewa memakai teknik khusus menempa tombak perang. Setelah bertarung lama, mereka berhasil menaklukkan naga jahat, melindungi wilayah itu. Tombak lalu lenyap dan bertahun-tahun tidak diketahui keberadaannya. Sampai baru-baru ini ditemukan di Valdroar. Tak ada yang tahu kok bisa ada di situ, tapi kekuatan tersembunyi si tombak tak ada yang hilang, dan memberi kekuatan untuk mengalahkan naga kepada siapa pun yang membawanya.
name: MST_SU_ARM_160_DESC
desc: Long ago, a brutal demon dragon appeared in another world. Made uneasy by its presence, the gods used a special technique to forge a battle lance. After a long fight they subjugated the evil dragon, thereby protecting the order of the land. The lance then disappeared and for many years its whereabouts were unknown, until recently when it was discovered in Valdroar. No one knows how it came to be left there, but none of the lance's hidden power had been lost, and it is said to bestow the power to defeat dragons upon whoever takes it in their hands.

raw.th: นานมาแล้ว, มังกรปีศาจผู้โหดร้ายปรากฏตัวในอีกโลกหนึ่ง ด้วยความไม่สบายใจกับการปรากฏตัวของมัน, เทพเจ้าใช้เทคนิคพิเศษในหารหลอมหลาวต่อสู้ขึ้นมา หลังจากการต่อสู้ที่ยาวนานพวกเขาปราบปรามมังกรชั่วร้าย, จึงสามารถฟื้นคืนความผาสุขของแผ่นดินได้ จากนั้นหลาวดังกลาวก็หายไปนานหลายปี มันอยู่ที่ไหนก็ไม่มีใครรู้, จนกระทั่งเร็วๆนี้มันถูกค้นพบที่วาลด์รอร์ ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าทำไมมึนจึงถูกทิ้งอยู่ที่นั่น, แต่พลังที่ซ่อนไว้ของหลาวไม่ได้หายไปเลยสักนิด, และมีการกล่าวถึงการให้อำนาจในการปราบมังกรให้แก่ผู้ที่ถือเอาไว้ในมือของพวกเขา

id: Pedang yang ditemukan di Tungku Kebangkitan Valdroar, selalu memancarkan kekuatan suci, dan yang lemah akan terbakar hanya dengan mendekat. Menurut satu teori, Tungku Kebangkitan dibangun murid Kaisar Saleh untuk membangkitkannya, dan pedang ini mereka siapkan khusus untuk diberikan kepada sang tuan ketika kembali. Diperkirakan punya cukup kekuatan untuk menghancurkan para dewa, tetapi mencari orang yang cukup kuat untuk membawa senjata tersebut sangatlah sulit.
name: MST_SU_ARM_170_DESC
desc: A sword discovered in the Resurrection Furnace of Valdroar, it constantly radiates a sacred power, and the weak are said to be annihilated just by approaching it. According to one theory, the Resurrection Furnace was built by disciples of the Pious Emperor in order to resurrect him, and this sword was specially prepared by them to bestow upon their master on his return. It is thought to have sufficient power to destroy even the gods, but finding someone with sufficient power to wield such a weapon has proven difficult.

id: Bilah kembar ditempa oleh dewa perang dunia lain yang katanya telah membunuh 100 dewa lain. Senjatanya terdiri dari pangkal pedang saja jika tidak dipakai, dan mengeluarkan bilah cahaya saat diperlukan untuk perang. Bilah ini beresonansi dengan semangat juang si pemegangnya, dan dapat membelah zirah seperti kertas di tangan yang benar. Bilah juga sepertinya bertumbuh dalam rantai serangan beruntun, dan katanya menjulang ke langit di tangan pencipta aslinya.
name: MST_SU_ARM_180_DESC
desc: Twin blades forged by an otherworldly god of war said to have slain 100 other deities. The weapons appear to be comprised of hilts alone when not in use, and emit blades of light when needed for battle. These blades resonate with the wielder's fighting spirit, and can cleave through armor like paper in the right hands. The blades also seem to grow over chains of consecutive attacks, and are said to have towered skyward in the hands of their original creator.

The blades also seem to grow over chains of consecutive attacks, and are said to have towered skyward in the hands of their original creator.
raw.th: ดาบคู่ที่หลอมขึ้นโดยเทพเจ้าแห่งสงครามจากต่างโลก ว่ากันว่าได้สังหารเทพอีก 100 ตน อาวุธเหล่านี้ดูเหมือนจะประกอบด้วยด้ามดาบเพียงอย่างเดียวเมื่อไม่ใช้ และปล่อยใบดาบแสงออกเมื่อจำเป็นสำหรับการสู้รบ คมดาบเหล่านี้สะท้อนกับวิญญาณของผู้สู้รบและสามารถตัดผ่านเกราะเหมือนกระดาษในมือขวา ใบดาบยังดูเหมือนจะเติบโตไปตามการโจมตีติดต่อกัน และมีการกล่าวถึงว่าได้ไต่เต้าขึ้นสุดฟ้าในมือของผู้สร้างเดิมของพวกเขา
raw.vi: Twin blades forged by an otherworldly god of war said to have slain 100 other deities. The weapons appear to be comprised of hilts alone when not in use, and emit blades of light when needed for battle. These blades resonate with the wielder's fighting spirit, and can cleave through armor like paper in the right hands. The blades also seem to grow over chains of consecutive attacks, and are said to have towered skyward in the hands of their original creator.

id: Jubah Pemanggil diberikan kepada Master Pemanggil sejati oleh Aula Pemanggil. Legenda berkata ini memegang jiwa 6 Pahlawan yang menginspirasi harapan manusia selama perang dengan dewa. Namun kekuatan jubah tidak dapat dipakai tanpa usaha besar dari pemakainya, dan sampai sekarang belum pernah dipakai maksimal. Legenda berkata jika mampu memaksimalkan jubah, juga akan mampu memanggil kekuatan mengatasi segala cobaan. Seperti 6 Pahlawan, seorang Pemanggil akan memimpin manusia menuju cahaya harapan.
name: MST_SU_ARM_7011_DESC
desc: A legendary robe bestowed upon true master Summoners by the Summoners' Hall. The legends tell us that it holds the souls of the Six Heroes who inspired hope in humanity during the war with the gods. However, the robe's power cannot be used without immense effort by the wearer, and it has never been utilized at its full potential to date. The legends hold that the being able to fully utilize this robe will also be able to summon the courage to overcome any trial. Just as the Six Heroes did, such a Summoner would lead humanity into the light of hope.

raw.th: เสื้อคลุมของตำนานนำเสนอแก่ปรมาจารย์ซัมมอนเนอร์ที่แท้จริงโดยสภาซัมมอนเนอร์ ตำนานบอกเราว่ามันมีวิญญาณของหกวีรบุรุษที่เป็นแรงบันดาลใจความหวังในมนุษยชาติในช่วงสงครามกับพระเจ้า อย่างไรก็ตามอำนาจของเสื้อคลุมไม่สามารถใช้งานได้โดยไม่ต้องใช้ความพยายามอันยิ่งใหญ่ของผู้สวมใส่ และไม่เคยมีการได้ใช้ประโยชน์อย่างเต็มที่จนถึงในปัจจุบัน ตำนานถือได้ว่าการสามารถใช้เสื้อคลุมนี้ได้อย่างเต็มที่จะสามารถเรียกความกล้าหาญเพื่อเอาชนะการทดสอบใดๆ ก็ได้ เช่นเดียวกับที่หกผู้กล้าทำ ซัมมอนเนอร์แบบนั้นจะนำพามวลมนุษยชาติไปสู่ความหวัง

id: A holy sword kept heavily guarded in the vaults of the Summoners' Hall. It is said to have been made using the absolute entirety of the power available to a certain group of gods, humans, and demons who longed for a fair and just world. Most hold that a single individual with this blade would be enough to turn the tide of any battle, and its divine blade has yet to sustain a single blemish.

id: A sacred scripture handed out to a select few Summoners. It contains the words of a matron goddess who rules over bountiful harvests and prosperity, and is said to have the power to ward off misfortune. Although there was once an era when clergy bearing these scriptures brought prosperity across the land, this descended into disorder due to improper use of the scriptures' powers. As a result, the Summoners' Hall now controls the remaining texts. Currently, the Summoners' Hall requires expertise in all fields of knowledge as a prerequisite for possession of a scripture.

id: Waktunya berdiskusi teknik bertempur dasar!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's time to discuss basic combat techniques!

raw.en: It's time to discuss basic combat techniques!
raw.es: Conoce las técnicas de combate básicas.
raw.id: Waktunya berdiskusi teknik bertempur dasar!
raw.pt: Chegou a hora de discutirmos técnicas básicas de combate!
raw.th: ถึงเวลาที่จะมาพูดคุยเกี่ยวกับเทคนิคการต่อสู้พื้นฐาน!
raw.vi: Đã đến lúc tranh luận về các kỹ thuật chiến đấu!

id: Ingatlah kekuatan dan kelemahan setiap elemen dan cara memicu Berani Ledak!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_2_DESCRIPTION
desc: Memorize the strengths and weaknesses of each elements and how to trigger the Brave Burst!

raw.en: Memorize the strengths and weaknesses of each elements and how to trigger the Brave Burst!
raw.es: Memoriza los puntos fuertes y débiles de cada elemento y aprende a usar el talento Brave Burst.
raw.id: Ingatlah kekuatan dan kelemahan setiap elemen dan cara memicu Berani Ledak!
raw.pt: Memorize pontos fortes e fracos de cada elemento e como ativar o Brave Burst!
raw.th: จดจำจุดแข็งและจุดอ่อนของแต่ละธาตุ และวิธีการที่จะใช้เบรฟเบิร์ส!
raw.vi: Ghi nhớ các điểm mạnh và điểm yếu của mỗi yếu tố và cách để tạo ra tiếng nổ lớn

id: Latihan tempur memakai semua yang dipelajari!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_3_DESCRIPTION
desc: Practice combat while using everything you've learned!

raw.en: Practice combat while using everything you've learned!
raw.es: Usa lo que has aprendido en una batalla de práctica.
raw.id: Latihan tempur memakai semua yang dipelajari!
raw.pt: Treine o combate enquanto usa tudo o que aprendeu!
raw.th: ฝึกการต่อสู้พร้อมกับใช้ทุกสิ่งที่คุณได้เรียนรู้มา!
raw.vi: Thực hành chiến đấu bằng cách áp dụng mọi điều mà bạn vừa mới học

id: Perjalananmu sebagai Pemanggil keliling Gaia Besar telah dimulai! Maju terus, dan jangan lupa yang diajarkan Tilith!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10_DESCRIPTION
desc: Your journey as a Summoner traveling across Grand Gaia has begun! Go forth, and don't forget what Tilith taught you!

raw.en: Your journey as a Summoner traveling across Grand Gaia has begun! Go forth, and don't forget what Tilith taught you!
raw.es: Inicia tu aventura como invocador por la vasta Gran Gaia. ¡No olvides todo lo que Tilith te ha enseñado!
raw.id: Perjalananmu sebagai Pemanggil keliling Gaia Besar telah dimulai! Maju terus, dan jangan lupa yang diajarkan Tilith!
raw.pt: Sua jornada como Invocador se aventurando por Grand Gaia começou! Siga adiante e não esqueça do que Tilith ensinou!
raw.th: เส้นทางการจะเป็นซัมมอนเนอร์ของคุณ ต้องข้ามผ่านแกรนด์ไกอาได้เริ่มต้นขึ้นแล้ว! ก้าวออกมา และอย่าลืมที่ทิลิธได้สอนคุณ
raw.vi: Cuộc hành trình của bạn trên vai trò là một Summoner đi qua Grand Gaia đã đươc bắt đầu, đừng quên những gì mà Tilith đã dạy bạn!

id: Padang rumput hijau tetap berjalan. Monster di sini pas buat pemula. Maju terus.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_11_DESCRIPTION
desc: The calm grasslands keep on going.The monsters here are just right for a beginner.Keep moving forward.

raw.en: The calm grasslands keep on going.The monsters here are just right for a beginner.Keep moving forward.
raw.es: Un extensa y tranquila pradera; los monstruos que la habitan son buenos rivales para un principiante. Adelante.
raw.id: Padang rumput hijau tetap berjalan. Monster di sini pas buat pemula. Maju terus.
raw.pt: Esses campos calmos seguem por um tempo. Os monstros daqui são alvos perfeitos para um novato. Continue avançando.
raw.th: ทุ่งหญ้าที่สงบสุขไกลสุดลูกหูลูกตา มอนสเตอร์ที่อยู่ที่นี่เหมาะสำหรับผู้เริ่มต้น จงก้าวต่อไป
raw.vi: Các bãi cỏ yên tĩnh vẫn nằm ở đó. Các con ma ở đây luôn trực chờ những người mới đến. Hãy tiến lên!

id: Kamu bisa melihat gunung batu samar-samar di horison. Tilith menunggu di Gua Kobaran di atas sana.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_12_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can see a rocky mountain faintly on the horizon. Tilith is waiting at the "Cave of Flames" just beyond here.

raw.en: You can see a rocky mountain faintly on the horizon. Tilith is waiting at the "Cave of Flames" just beyond here.
raw.es: En el horizonte divisas una rocosa montaña; tras ella, Tilith te espera en la cueva de magma.
raw.id: Kamu bisa melihat gunung batu samar-samar di horison. Tilith menunggu di Gua Kobaran di atas sana.
raw.pt: Você mal consegue ver uma montanha rochosa no horizonte. Tilith está esperando na “Caverna das Chamas” que fica além daqui.
raw.th: คุณสามารถมองเห็นภูเขาหินลางๆ อยู่บนเส้นขอบฟ้า ทิลิธกำลังรอคุณอยู่ที่ 'ถ้ำแห่งเปลวเพลิง' หลังภูเขาลูกนั้น
raw.vi: Bạn có thể nhìn thấy núi đá bằng phẳng phía chân trời. Tilith đang đợi bạn ở "hang lửa".

id: Magma mengalir dalam gua ini memberi panas intens. Musuh di gua ini punya kekuatan api.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_20_DESCRIPTION
desc: The magma flowing within this cave gives off an intense heat. The enemies in this cave have the power of fire.

raw.en: The magma flowing within this cave gives off an intense heat. The enemies in this cave have the power of fire.
raw.es: El magma que escurre por la cueva hace que el calor sea abrasador. Aquí te enfrentarás a enemigos afines al fuego.
raw.id: Magma mengalir dalam gua ini memberi panas intens. Musuh di gua ini punya kekuatan api.
raw.pt: A lava fluindo dentro desta caverna é de um calor intenso. Os inimigos nesta caverna têm o poder do fogo.
raw.th: แมกม่าที่ไหลอยู่ภายในถ้ำแห่งนี้ ทำให้มีความร้อนที่รุนแรง ศัตรูที่อยู่ภายในถ้ำที่มีพลังของไฟ
raw.vi: Các dòng nham thạch đang chảy trong hang này khiến bao người run sợ. Các kẻ thù trong hang có phép thuật về lửa.

id: Lanjut masuk ke Gua Kobaran. Makhluk pengontrol api menunggu di depan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_21_DESCRIPTION
desc: Continue deeper into the Cave of Flames. Beings who control fire are waiting ahead.

raw.en: Continue deeper into the Cave of Flames. Beings who control fire are waiting ahead.
raw.es: Avanza por la cueva de magma; más adelante te esperan unos seres de fuego.
raw.id: Lanjut masuk ke Gua Kobaran. Makhluk pengontrol api menunggu di depan.
raw.pt: Continue explorando a Caverna das Chamas mais a fundo. Seres que controlam o fogo aguardam adiante.
raw.th: ลึกเข้าไปภายในถ้ำแห่งเปลวไฟ สิ่งมีชีวิตที่ควบคุมไฟกำลังรออยู่เบื้องหน้า
raw.vi: Đi sâu vào trong hang lửa. Hãy là người chiến đấu với lửa đang bùng cháy phía trước

id: Kamu sudah cukup jauh, tapi tidak ada jalan keluar di situs. Seharusnya ada bandit di area ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_22_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've come far, but there's still no exit in site. There are supposed to be bandits in this area.

raw.en: You've come far, but there's still no exit in site. There are supposed to be bandits in this area.
raw.es: Llegaste lejos, pero no hay salida a la vista. Cuentan que por esta zona hay bandidos.
raw.id: Kamu sudah cukup jauh, tapi tidak ada jalan keluar di situs. Seharusnya ada bandit di area ini.
raw.pt: Você chegou longe, mas ainda não pode ver a saída. Deve haver bandidos nessa área.
raw.th: คุณมาไกลแล้ว แต่ยังคงไม่เจอทางออก และเหมือนว่ามันจะมีโจรอยู่ในพื้นที่แถวนี้
raw.vi: Bạn muốn ra khỏi nơi đây nhưng không có lối thoát nào ở đây cả và có rất nhiều băng cướp trong khu này.

id: Sepertinya kamu bisa meninggalkan gua ini segera, tapi ada yang keji menunggumu di ujung.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_23_DESCRIPTION
desc: Looks like you'll be able to leave this cave soon, but there seems to be something sinister awaiting you at the end.

raw.en: Looks like you'll be able to leave this cave soon, but there seems to be something sinister awaiting you at the end.
raw.es: Parece que pronto podrás abandonar la cueva pero... algo siniestro te aguarda al final del camino.
raw.id: Sepertinya kamu bisa meninggalkan gua ini segera, tapi ada yang keji menunggumu di ujung.
raw.pt: Parece que você vai poder sair da caverna em breve e também parece haver algo sinistro esperando por você no fim.
raw.th: ดูเหมือนว่าคุณจะสามารถออกจากถ้ำแห่งนี้ได้ในไม่ช้า แต่ดูเหมือนว่าจะมีสิ่งที่น่ากลัวรอคุณอยู่ในตอนจบ
raw.vi: Dường như bạn sắp rời được hang rồi nhưng vẫn còn một số nguy hiểm đang đợi bạn ở chặng cuối

id: Kamu keluar dari badai salju. Sangat dingin, hati-hati terhadap musuh dengan serangan air.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_30_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've emerged into a blizzard. It's so cold, watch out for enemies with water attacks.

raw.en: You've emerged into a blizzard. It's so cold, watch out for enemies with water attacks.
raw.es: Al salir te encuentras en medio de una gélida ventisca. Cuidado con los enemigos afines al agua.
raw.id: Kamu keluar dari badai salju. Sangat dingin, hati-hati terhadap musuh dengan serangan air.
raw.pt: Você entrou em uma nevasca. Está muito frio, tome cuidado com inimigos que usam ataques de água.
raw.th: คุณได้หลุดเข้าไปในพายุหิมะ มันหนาวมาก และให้ระวังศัตรูที่โจมตีด้วยธาตุน้ำ
raw.vi: Bạn vừa mới bị cuốn vào bão tuyết. Thật là lạnh, hãy coi chừng các kẻ thù tấn công từ dưới mặt nước

id: Kamu membuat kemajuan, tapi akhir dari pemandangan salju ini masih tidak terlihat. Jangan lupa rencana untuk musuh berelemen air.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_31_DESCRIPTION
desc: You are making progress, but the end of the snowscape still isn't visible. Don't forget to plan for water enemies.

raw.en: You are making progress, but the end of the snowscape still isn't visible. Don't forget to plan for water enemies.
raw.es: Avanzas por la meseta helada sin avistar su final. No olvides protegerte de los enemigos afines al agua.
raw.id: Kamu membuat kemajuan, tapi akhir dari pemandangan salju ini masih tidak terlihat. Jangan lupa rencana untuk musuh berelemen air.
raw.pt: Você está progredindo, mas ainda não pode ver o fim desse terreno gelado. Não se esqueça do plano para inimigos de água.
raw.th: คุณก้าวหน้าไปมาก แต่ก็ยังมองไม่เห้นตอนปลายของถ้ำหิมะเลยอย่าลืมที่จะวางแผนรับมือสำหรับศัตรูธาตุน้ำ
raw.vi: Bạn đang tiến bộ rất nhiều nhưng chặng cuối của vùng phủ tuyết này sẽ rất khó quan sát đấy! Đừng quên lên kế hoạch đối  phó trước những kẻ thù ở dưới nước

id: Kamu telah mencapai bagian tengah lahan es. Hati-hati, katanya ada bajak latu di atas es…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_32_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've reached the center of the icy field. Beware, apparently there are pirates about on the ice...

raw.en: You've reached the center of the icy field. Beware, apparently there are pirates about on the ice...
raw.es: Has llegado al centro de la meseta helada. Ve con cuidado, pues por aquí merodean piratas.
raw.id: Kamu telah mencapai bagian tengah lahan es. Hati-hati, katanya ada bajak latu di atas es…
raw.pt: Você chegou ao meio do campo nevado. Cuidado, parece que há piratas por perto...
raw.th: คุณได้มาถึงใจกลางของทุ่งน้ำแข็ง ระวัง เพราะเห็นได้ชัดว่ามีโจรสลัดที่อยู่บนน้ำแข็งนั่น...
raw.vi: Bạn vừa mới tiến đến trung tâm của cánh đồng băng. Hãy cẩn thận, có rất nhiều ma cà rồng ở đây!

id: Di ujung ladang es dingin ini akhirnya terlihat juga. Sepertinya salah satu ksatria Maxwell menunggu di depan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_33_DESCRIPTION
desc: The end of this cold snow field has come into view at last. However, it seems one of Maxwell's knights is waiting just ahead.

raw.en: The end of this cold snow field has come into view at last. However, it seems one of Maxwell's knights is waiting just ahead.
raw.es: Por fin divisas el final de la meseta helada. Por desgracia, uno de los caballeros de Maxwell te espera más adelante.
raw.id: Di ujung ladang es dingin ini akhirnya terlihat juga. Sepertinya salah satu ksatria Maxwell menunggu di depan.
raw.pt: Finalmente dá para ver o fim desse campo gelado. Mas parece que um dos cavaleiros do Maxwell aguarda adiante.
raw.th: ในที่สุดคุณก็เข้ามาเห็น ทุ่งหิมะอันหนาวเหน็บตอนจบ อย่างไรก็ดี ดูเหมือนว่าหนึ่งในอัศวินแมกซ์เวลกำลังรออยู่ข้างหน้าแล้ว
raw.vi: Chặng cuối của cánh đồng tuyết lạnh giá này đã trở nên dễ dàng quan sát cho bạn. Tuy nhiên dường như vẫn còn một kiếm khách Maxwell đang đợi bạn phía trước

id: Setelah melewati ladang salju ada hutan yang tidak bisa ditembus matahari. Hati-hati, ada tanda kalau banyak monster di sana.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_40_DESCRIPTION
desc: Beyond the snow lie the forests that the sun doesn't reach. Beware, there are signs of monsters are all around.

raw.en: Beyond the snow lie the forests that the sun doesn't reach. Beware, there are signs of monsters are all around.
raw.es: Más allá de estas nieves eternas hay un bosque al que la luz del sol no llega. Ten cuidado, está plagado de monstruos.
raw.id: Setelah melewati ladang salju ada hutan yang tidak bisa ditembus matahari. Hati-hati, ada tanda kalau banyak monster di sana.
raw.pt: Depois da neve chegará a floresta em que o sol não entra. Cuidado, a sinais de monstros por toda a parte.
raw.th: นอกเหนือจากหิมะในป่าที่ดวงอาทิตย์ส่องแสงไปไม่ถึง ระวัง มันมีสัญญาณของสัตว์ร้ายอยู่รอบๆ ตัว
raw.vi: Phía trước cánh đồng tuyết là những khu rừng mà đến cả tia sáng mặt trời cũng không thể lọt qua. Hãy cẩn thận,  có những dấu vết của ma quỷ ở khắp nơi đây

id: Hutan yang penuh monster tidak berakhir. Semua sama, sepertinya kamu hanya berjalan berputar-putar…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_41_DESCRIPTION
desc: This monster-packed forest just goes on forever. Everything's the same, seems like you're walking in circles...

raw.en: This monster-packed forest just goes on forever. Everything's the same, seems like you're walking in circles...
raw.es: Este bosque infestado de enemigos parece infinito. El paisaje te resulta familiar... ¿Estarás andando en círculos?
raw.id: Hutan yang penuh monster tidak berakhir. Semua sama, sepertinya kamu hanya berjalan berputar-putar…
raw.pt: Esta floresta cheia de monstros não acaba nunca. Tudo é igual, parece que está andando em círculos...
raw.th: ป่าที่เต็มไปด้วยสัตว์ประหลาดนี้ โผล่ออกมาอย่างไม่มีที่สิ้นสุด ทุกอย่างเหมือนกับว่าคุณกำลังเดินเป็นวงกลม ...
raw.vi: Khu rừng đầy ma quỷ này vẫn còn vô tận. Mọi thứ dường như đều giống nhau khiến bạn cảm thấy mình như đang lạc vào một mê cung

id: Katanya bandit menempati hutan ini. Mereka mungkin tangguh, tapi tak ada jalan menghindari mereka.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_42_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's said that bandits occupy this forest. They may be tough, but there's no way to avoid them.

raw.en: It's said that bandits occupy this forest. They may be tough, but there's no way to avoid them.
raw.es: Cuentan que en este bosque viven unos bandidos; tendrás que enfrentarlos por muy formidables que sean.
raw.id: Katanya bandit menempati hutan ini. Mereka mungkin tangguh, tapi tak ada jalan menghindari mereka.
raw.pt: Dizem que bandidos ocupam a floresta. Eles podem ser difíceis de vencer, mas não há como evitá-los.
raw.th: กล่าวกันว่าพวกโจรครอบครองป่าแห่งนี้ มันอาจจะผ่านไปยาก แต่ไม่มีทางไหนที่จะหลีกเลี่ยงพวกมันได้
raw.vi: Người ta nói rằng các nhóm cướp đã chiếm mất khu rừng này. Chúng là những kẻ khó nuốt và khó có thể tránh được chúng.

id: Pemburu berbahaya membawa busur panjang menghuni bagian dalam hutan ini, dan mereka menyerang siapa pun yang berani masuk.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_43_DESCRIPTION
desc: Dangerous hunters wielding longbows inhabit the depths of this forest, and they attack anyone who dares enter.

raw.en: Dangerous hunters wielding longbows inhabit the depths of this forest, and they attack anyone who dares enter.
raw.es: Unos peligrosos cazadores armados con arcos viven en el corazón del bosque; atacan a los intrusos, así que cuidado.
raw.id: Pemburu berbahaya membawa busur panjang menghuni bagian dalam hutan ini, dan mereka menyerang siapa pun yang berani masuk.
raw.pt: Caçadores perigosos com arcos longos habitam as profundezas da floresta e atacam qualquer um que ouse entrar.
raw.th: นักล่าที่อันตรายผู้ใช้ธนู อาศัยอยู่ในส่วนลึกของป่าแห่งนี้ และพวกเขาโจมตีทุกคนที่กล้าย่างกรายเข้ามา
raw.vi: Những tên đi săn nguy hiểm đang nắm giữ cung tên để bắn vào sâu trong khu rừng này, chúng tấn công bất cứ ai mà dám đi vào bên trong

id: Guntur terkadang menggelegar di tanah lembab ini. Cukup tidak enak di sini. Bersiaplah untuk guntur.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_50_DESCRIPTION
desc: Lightning occasionally roars throughout this damp land. It's quite unpleasant here. Prepare yourself for thunder.

raw.en: Lightning occasionally roars throughout this damp land. It's quite unpleasant here. Prepare yourself for thunder.
raw.es: En este pantano se escucha de vez en cuando el clamor de los truenos. No es un sitio agradable... Prepárate para enfrentarte al trueno.
raw.id: Guntur terkadang menggelegar di tanah lembab ini. Cukup tidak enak di sini. Bersiaplah untuk guntur.
raw.pt: Esta terra molhada é atingida por raios com frequência. É muito desagradável ficar aqui. Prepare-se para o trovão.
raw.th: เสียงฟ้าผ่าดังคำรามเป็นครั้งคราว ไปทั่วทั้งแผ่นดินชื้นนี้ ที่นี่ไม่ค่อยน่าพิสมัย เตรียมตัวคุณรับมือกับสายฟ้า
raw.vi: Sấm chớp gầm gừ trên mảnh đất lầy lội này. Rất khó chịu khi ở đây. Hãy chuẩn bị tinh thần để đối phó với sấm chớp

id: Sepertinya rawa yang luas. Tanah ini mungkin lebih menyulitkan daripada musuh yang mempunyai guntur yang bersembunyi di dalamnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_51_DESCRIPTION
desc: It looks to be a vast wetland. The terrain may prove more troublesome than the thunder-wielding enemies hiding in it.

raw.en: It looks to be a vast wetland. The terrain may prove more troublesome than the thunder-wielding enemies hiding in it.
raw.es: Se trata de una vasta zona pantanosa; puede que el terreno te dé más problemas que los enemigos afines al trueno que en él se ocultan.
raw.id: Sepertinya rawa yang luas. Tanah ini mungkin lebih menyulitkan daripada musuh yang mempunyai guntur yang bersembunyi di dalamnya.
raw.pt: Parece um pântano bem vasto. O terreno pode se provar mais desafiador do que os inimigos portadores do trovão que se escondem nele.
raw.th: ดูเหมือนจะเป็นพื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำที่กว้างใหญ่ ภูมิประเทศอาจสร้างความลำบากมากกว่าศัตรูสายฟ้าที่ซ่อนตัวอยู่ในนั้น
raw.vi: Đây là một vùng đất ngập nước rộng lớn. Khu này có vẻ còn nguy hiểm hơn cả kẻ thù sớm chớp đang ẩn nấp ở đó

id: Sepertinya juga ada bandit di sekita sini. Mereka biasa menyebut langit itu punya mereka, kekuatan apa yang telah mengambil…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_52_DESCRIPTION
desc: Seems there are bandits around here, too. They used to call the skies their own, but what strength that must've taken...

raw.en: Seems there are bandits around here, too. They used to call the skies their own, but what strength that must've taken...
raw.es: Por lo visto, también hay bandidos en esta zona. Afirman que el cielo les pertenecía... ¿Imaginas la fuerza que han de tener para reclamar algo así?
raw.id: Sepertinya juga ada bandit di sekita sini. Mereka biasa menyebut langit itu punya mereka, kekuatan apa yang telah mengambil…
raw.pt: Parece que os bandidos estão por aqui também. Eles constumavam achar que eram donos do céu, e isso devia precisar de muita força...
raw.th: ดูเหมือนว่ามีโจรอยู่รอบ ๆ ที่นี่ด้วย พวกโจรเคยประกาศว่า น่านฟ้านี้เป็นของพวกมัน แต่พวกนั้นจะมีความแข็งแกร่งขนาดไหน ...
raw.vi: Dường như cũng có rất nhiều cướp ở đây. Chúng coi đây là vùng trời của riêng mình, những sức mạnh nào bạn cần có để đối phó với chúng?

id: Di ujung rawa yang tidak nyaman ini, jalannya dibuntuh oleh bekas pahlawan di Gaia Besar yang dipanggil oleh Maxwell.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_53_DESCRIPTION
desc: At the end of these unpleasant wetlands the way is blocked by a former hero of Grand Gaia who was summoned by Maxwell.

raw.en: At the end of these unpleasant wetlands the way is blocked by a former hero of Grand Gaia who was summoned by Maxwell.
raw.es: Al final de este horrible pantano, un antiguo héroe de Gran Gaia te impide el paso. Maxwell lo invocó.
raw.id: Di ujung rawa yang tidak nyaman ini, jalannya dibuntuh oleh bekas pahlawan di Gaia Besar yang dipanggil oleh Maxwell.
raw.pt: O caminho ao final desse pântano está bloqueado por um antigo herói de Grand Gaia que foi invocado por Maxwell.
raw.th: ในตอนท้ายของพื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำช่างไม่น่าพิสมัย หนทางเหล่านี้ถูกกั้นขวางโดยอดีตผู้กล้าของแกรนด์ไกอา ที่ถูกเรียกมาโดยแมกซ์เวล
raw.vi: Ở chặng cuối của vùng đất ngập nước khó chịu này, con đường bị phong tỏa bởi một vị anh hùng cổ xưa là Grand Gaia- một vị tướng của đức thần Maxwell

id: Reruntuhan kuno ini punya aura yang khusyuk dan suci. Lebih baik daripada di mana kamu sebelumnya, tapi masih bukan pertanda baik.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_60_DESCRIPTION
desc: These ancient ruins have a solemn, holy air. It's much better than where you were before, but it's still ominous.

raw.en: These ancient ruins have a solemn, holy air. It's much better than where you were before, but it's still ominous.
raw.es: Estas antiguas ruinas están envueltas en un aura sacra, solemne. El lugar tiene un mejor aspecto que tu anterior parada, pero aun así no es agradable.
raw.id: Reruntuhan kuno ini punya aura yang khusyuk dan suci. Lebih baik daripada di mana kamu sebelumnya, tapi masih bukan pertanda baik.
raw.pt: Essas ruínas antigas têm uma atmosfera tranquila e sagrada. É bem melhor aqui do que onde você estava antes, mas o lugar não deixa de ser sinistro.
raw.th: ซากปรักหักพังโบราณเหล่านี้มีความน่าขนลุก อากาศศักดิ์สิทธิ์ มันดีกว่าสถานที่ซึ่งคุณได้ไปมาก่อน แต่ก็ยังคงมีลางสังหรณ์ที่ไม่ดี
raw.vi: Các đống đổ nát xưa kia có một bầu không khí yên tĩnh. Nó là nơi tốt hơn nhiều so với những nơi trước đây nhưng vẫn có nhiều điềm xấu

id: Sepertinya seorang bijak dengan kekuatan terang ada di reruntuhan. Seorang penjaga, mungkin?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_61_DESCRIPTION
desc: It appears that a sage with the power of light is in the ruins. A guardian, perhaps?

raw.en: It appears that a sage with the power of light is in the ruins. A guardian, perhaps?
raw.es: Por lo visto, un ser de luz ronda estas ruinas. ¿Estará aquí para vigilarlas, quizá?
raw.id: Sepertinya seorang bijak dengan kekuatan terang ada di reruntuhan. Seorang penjaga, mungkin?
raw.pt: Parece que há um sábio com o poder da luz nessas ruínas. Talvez seja um guardião.
raw.th: ดูเหมือนว่านักปราชญ์ที่พลังแห่งแสง จะอยู่ในซากปรักหักพัง เป็นผู้พิทักษ์หรือเปล่า?
raw.vi: Dường như rằng vị Hiền nhân có sức mạnh ánh sáng đang bị giam trong đống đổ nát này. Chúng ta cần phải cứu vị đó ra khỏi đấy!

id: Kuda putih besar dan bersinar memblokir jalan. Dia mempertahankan posisinya, menyerang tanpa ampun.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_62_DESCRIPTION
desc: A shining, gallant white horse blocks the path. It defends its position, attacking mercilessly.

raw.en: A shining, gallant white horse blocks the path. It defends its position, attacking mercilessly.
raw.es: Un imponente caballo blanco te bloquea el paso; defenderá su posición con fiereza, así que ten cuidado con sus ataques.
raw.id: Kuda putih besar dan bersinar memblokir jalan. Dia mempertahankan posisinya, menyerang tanpa ampun.
raw.pt: Um cavalo branco majestoso e brilhante está no caminho. Ele defende a própria posição atacando sem misericórdia.
raw.th: ม้าขาวสง่างามเปล่งแสงยืนกั้นขวางทางอยู่ มันป้องกันตำแหน่งของมันและโจมตีอย่างไร้ความปราณี
raw.vi: Một chú ngựa trắng dũng cảm đang chặn con đường này. Nó luôn phòng thủ ở đó và tấn công bất cứ ai

id: Prajurit terang menunggu di kedalaman reruntuhan ini, menguji para petualang sebelum mereka boleh lewat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_63_DESCRIPTION
desc: A warrior of light lies in wait in the depths of these ruins, testing adventurers before they're allowed to pass.

raw.en: A warrior of light lies in wait in the depths of these ruins, testing adventurers before they're allowed to pass.
raw.es: Un ser de luz aguarda paciente en las profundidades de estas ruinas para poner a prueba a los aventureros antes de dejarlos pasar.
raw.id: Prajurit terang menunggu di kedalaman reruntuhan ini, menguji para petualang sebelum mereka boleh lewat.
raw.pt: Um guerreiro de luz está esperando nas profundezas das ruínas, testando a força dos aventureiros antes de permitir a passagem.
raw.th: นักรบแห่งแสงซุ่มอยู่ในที่อยู่ในส่วนลึกของซากปรักหักพัง ทดสอบนักผจญภัยก่อนที่พวกเขาจะได้รับอนุญาตให้ผ่าน
raw.vi: Một chiến binh ánh sáng đang đợi bạn ở cuối chặng của đống đổ nát này, hãy thử thách đội quân của mình trước khi vượt qua đống đổ nát đó!

id: Mansion mengerikan yang membuat bulu kuduk berdiri dengan aura kejahatannya. Kamu akan perlu kekuatan untuk melawan kegelapan di sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_70_DESCRIPTION
desc: This spine-chillingly eerie mansion reeks of an evil presence. Here you'll need the power to oppose darkness.

raw.en: This spine-chillingly eerie mansion reeks of an evil presence. Here you'll need the power to oppose darkness.
raw.es: Esta lúgubre mansión está impregnada de una malévola presencia. Para derrotarla, necesitarás un poder capaz de oponerse a la oscuridad.
raw.id: Mansion mengerikan yang membuat bulu kuduk berdiri dengan aura kejahatannya. Kamu akan perlu kekuatan untuk melawan kegelapan di sini.
raw.pt: Esta mansão arrepiante tem um ar carregado com uma presença maligna. Você vai precisar de poder para se opor à sombra daqui.
raw.th: นี่คือคฤหาสน์อันน่าขนลุกของปีศาจ มันคือการปรากฏตัวของความชั่วร้าย ที่นี่คุณจะต้องการอำนาจในการต่อต้านความมืด
raw.vi: Lâu đài kỳ quái, lạnh lẽo sởn gai ốc này đang có rất nhiều tai họa rình rập ở đó. Do đó, bạn cần phải có sức mạnh để chiến đấu với bóng đêm ở đó.

id: Energi terang kuat melawan kegelapan, tapi juga merupakan kelemahannya. Kamu harus mengatur strategimu dengan hati-hati.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_71_DESCRIPTION
desc: Light energy is strong against dark, but it's also its weakness. You must plan your strategy here carefully.

raw.en: Light energy is strong against dark, but it's also its weakness. You must plan your strategy here carefully.
raw.es: Aquí se enfrentan las energías antagónicas de la luz y de la oscuridad. Debes planear tu estrategia con cuidado.
raw.id: Energi terang kuat melawan kegelapan, tapi juga merupakan kelemahannya. Kamu harus mengatur strategimu dengan hati-hati.
raw.pt: A energia da luz é forte contra a sombra, mas também a tem como fraqueza. É preciso montar uma estratégia com cuidado.
raw.th: พลังงานแสงมีความแข็งแรงต้านทานความมืด แต่มันก็ยังอ่อนแอ คุณต้องวางแผนกลยุทธ์ของคุณที่นี่อย่างระมัดระวัง
raw.vi: Sức mạnh ánh sáng đang chiến đấu với sức mạnh của bóng đêm. Bạn phải lên kế hoạch chiến lược một cách cẩn thận khi ở đây!

id: Monster dengan tangan ular telah muncul. Hati-hati, tampaknya banyak petualang yang kalah oleh kekuatannya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_72_DESCRIPTION
desc: A monster with snakes for arms has appeared. Beware, it seems many adventurers have been subdued by its strength.

raw.en: A monster with snakes for arms has appeared. Beware, it seems many adventurers have been subdued by its strength.
raw.es: Un monstruo con serpientes en vez de brazos aparece ante ti. Ten cuidado, muchos aventureros han caído ante él.
raw.id: Monster dengan tangan ular telah muncul. Hati-hati, tampaknya banyak petualang yang kalah oleh kekuatannya.
raw.pt: Um monstro com cobras no lugar dos braços apareceu. Cuidado, parece que muitos aventureiros não suportaram a força dele.
raw.th: สัตว์ร้ายที่มีแขนเป็นงูได้ปรากฏตัวขึ้น ระวัง ดูเหมือนว่านักผจญภัยจำนวนมากกำจัดโดยความแข็งแกร่งของมัน
raw.vi: Một con ma rắn có nhiều cánh tay vừa mới xuất hiện. Hãy cẩn thận bởi vì đã có rất nhiều kẻ mạo hiểm đã bị chúng đánh bại!

id: Jago pedang mengerikan menunggumu, dan kamu harus menang melawannya untuk mencapai Menara Mistral.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_73_DESCRIPTION
desc: A grotesque swordsman awaits you, and you must overcome him in order to reach the Tower of Mistral.

raw.en: A grotesque swordsman awaits you, and you must overcome him in order to reach the Tower of Mistral.
raw.es: Un paladín de aspecto grotesco será tu próximo enemigo. Para llegar a la torre de Mistral, tendrás que derrotarlo.
raw.id: Jago pedang mengerikan menunggumu, dan kamu harus menang melawannya untuk mencapai Menara Mistral.
raw.pt: Um espadachim grotesco espera por você e é preciso vencê-lo para chegar à Torre de Mistral.
raw.th: นักดาบพิลึกรอคุณอยู่ และคุณต้องเอาชนะเขาเพื่อที่จะไปให้ถึงหอคอยแห่งมิสทราล
raw.vi: Một tay kiếm lố bịch đang đợi bạn ở đó, bạn phải thắng được anh ta để tiến tới Tháp Mistral.

id: Akhirnya kamu mendapai Menara Mistral. Ini adalah basis Maxwell di Mistral. Ayo cepat masuk!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_81_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've reached the Tower of Mistral at last. This is Maxwell's base inside Mistral. Hurry your way inside!

raw.en: You've reached the Tower of Mistral at last. This is Maxwell's base inside Mistral. Hurry your way inside!
raw.es: ¡Por fin llegaste a la torre de Mistral! Maxwell se encuentra atrincherado en su interior. ¡Rápido, entra!
raw.id: Akhirnya kamu mendapai Menara Mistral. Ini adalah basis Maxwell di Mistral. Ayo cepat masuk!
raw.pt: Você finalmente chegou à Torre de Mistral. Esta é a base do Maxwell em Mistra. Entre depressa!
raw.th: คุณได้มาถึงหอคอยแห่งมิสทราล นี่เป็นฐานของแมกซ์เวลภายในมิสทราล รีบหน่อย! เส้นทางของคุณอยู่ด้านใน!
raw.vi: Cuối cùng, bạn đã tiến tới Tháp Mistral. Đây là căn cứ của Maxwell ở Mistral. Hãy nhanh chóng vào bên trong đó!

id: Menara ini ketinggiannya mencapai langit. Monster  yang menakutkan menunggu dengan cakar yang berlumuran darah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_82_DESCRIPTION
desc: This tower reaches amazingly high into the sky. Fearsome monsters await with blood-soaked claws.

raw.en: This tower reaches amazingly high into the sky. Fearsome monsters await with blood-soaked claws.
raw.es: La imponente torre se alza a gran altura. En ella te esperan horribles monstruos sedientos de sangre.
raw.id: Menara ini ketinggiannya mencapai langit. Monster  yang menakutkan menunggu dengan cakar yang berlumuran darah.
raw.pt: Esta torre atinge uma altura incrível. Monstros temíveis aguardam com garras ensanguentadas.
raw.th: หอคอยแห่งนี้สูงขึ้นไปถึงบนท้องฟ้าอย่างน่าอัศจรรย์ใจ สัตว์ร้ายที่น่ากลัวรอคอยพร้อมกับกรงเล็บเลือด
raw.vi: Khu tháp Mistral này có thể lên tới tận bầu trời nhưng vẫn còn một số con ma đáng sợ ở đó, chúng có các càng dính đầy máu.

id: Setengah jalan, naga besar terban mempertahankan menara, menyerang siapa pun yang mendekat. Kamu harus menghindari serangannya untuk maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_83_DESCRIPTION
desc: Halfway up, a giant flying dragon is defends the tower, attacking anyone who nears. You must avoid it's attacks to advance.

raw.en: Halfway up, a giant flying dragon is defends the tower, attacking anyone who nears. You must avoid it's attacks to advance.
raw.es: A medio camino te encuentras con un enorme dragón volador que te impide acercarte a la torre con sus feroces ataques. Deberás evitarlos a toda costa.
raw.id: Setengah jalan, naga besar terban mempertahankan menara, menyerang siapa pun yang mendekat. Kamu harus menghindari serangannya untuk maju.
raw.pt: No meio da subida há um dragão voador que defende a torre de todos que se aproximarem. Você precisa evitar os ataques dele para avançar.
raw.th: เหลืออีกครึ่งทาง มังกรบินยักษ์ที่คอยปกป้องหอคอย จะโจมตีทุกคนที่เข้ามาใกล้ คุณต้องหลีกเลี่ยงการโจมตีของพวกมัน
raw.vi: Bạn đã đi được một nửa chặng đường rồi, một con rồng lớn biết bay đang phòng thủ ở Tháp và tấn công bất kỳ ai tới gần đó. Bạn phải tránh xa những đòn tấn công của nó để tiến lên phía trước

id: Penguasa dari empat element menunggu sebagai halangan terakhir sebelum bertemu tuan dari menara.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_84_DESCRIPTION
desc: Masters of each of the four elements stand in wait as the final barrier in the path to the lord of the tower.

raw.en: Masters of each of the four elements stand in wait as the final barrier in the path to the lord of the tower.
raw.es: Antes de llegar hasta el amo de la torre deberás derrotar a los maestros de los cuatro elementos que te bloquean el paso.
raw.id: Penguasa dari empat element menunggu sebagai halangan terakhir sebelum bertemu tuan dari menara.
raw.pt: Mestres de quatro elementos são os últimos obstáculos antes de chegar no senhor da torre.
raw.th: ปรมาจารย์ของแต่ละธาตุทั้งสี่ยืนรอคอยอยู่ เป็นอุปสรรคสุดท้ายในเส้นทางที่ไปยังสู่จ้าวแห่งหอคอย
raw.vi: Các vị cai quản bốn yếu tố đang đứng đợi bạn ở hàng rào cuối cùng trước khi bạn có thể tiến tới vị thần tể của ngọn Tháp này/

id: Kamu hampir sampai ke atas. Makhluk mekanik, mungkin buatan Maxwell, menunggumu. Pertarungan terakhir untuk Mistral dimulai.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_85_DESCRIPTION
desc: You're almost at the top. A mechanical deity, likely Maxwell's creation, awaits. The final battle for Mistral begins.

raw.en: You're almost at the top. A mechanical deity, likely Maxwell's creation, awaits. The final battle for Mistral begins.
raw.es: Casi llegas a lo más alto. Ahora lucharás contra una deidad mecánica, posible obra de Maxwell. Empieza la batalla definitiva por liberar Mistral.
raw.id: Kamu hampir sampai ke atas. Makhluk mekanik, mungkin buatan Maxwell, menunggumu. Pertarungan terakhir untuk Mistral dimulai.
raw.pt: Você está quase no topo. Uma divindade mecânica aguarda, provavelmente seja obra do Maxwell. A batalha final de Mistral começa.
raw.th: คุณเกือบจะถึงด้านบนสุดแล้ว กลไกลเทพที่ดูเหมือนว่าแมกซ์เวลจะสร้างขึ้นกำลังรออยู่ การต่อสู้ครั้งสุดท้ายเพื่อมิสทราลกำลังเริ่มต้นขึ้น
raw.vi: Bạn dường như sắp đến điểm trên cùng của ngọn tháp.  Một vị thần người máy do Maxwell tạo ra đang đợi bạn. Cuộc chiến đấu cuối cùng để vào tháp Mistral sắp bắt đầu!

id: Ada pegunungan di akhir Dataran Egor, tempat tidurnya dewa jahat yang dahulu menghancurkan beberapa negara kecil.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_90_DESCRIPTION
desc: There is a mountain range at the end of the Egor Plains where it is said an evil god who once destroyed several small nations slumbers.

raw.en: There is a mountain range at the end of the Egor Plains where it is said an evil god who once destroyed several small nations slumbers.
raw.es: Hay una cadena montañosa al final de las Llanuras Egor donde se dice que descansa un dios maligno que antaño destruyó varias naciones pequeñas.
raw.id: Ada pegunungan di akhir Dataran Egor, tempat tidurnya dewa jahat yang dahulu menghancurkan beberapa negara kecil.
raw.pt: Existe uma cadeia de montanhas ao final das Planícies de Egor, onde dizem que dorme um deus perverso que destruiu várias pequenas nações.
raw.th: มีภูเขาตั้งตระหง่านอยู่ตรงปลายที่ราบอีกอร์ ที่ๆ ว่ากันว่า เทพผู้ชั่วร้ายที่เคยทำลายประเทศเล็กๆ หลายประเทศ หลับไหลอยู่
raw.vi: Có một dãy núi trải dài cuối của Bình nguyên Egor, nơi được cho là có một vị ác thần đã từng phá hủy vài quốc gia nhỏ đang say giấc ngủ.

id: Perjalananmu melalu Morgan dimulai di padang pasir besar. Panas yang membara adalah indikasi perang sengit yang akan datang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_200_DESCRIPTION
desc: Your journey through Morgan begins in a huge desert. The scorching haze indicates the fierce battle to come.

raw.en: Your journey through Morgan begins in a huge desert. The scorching haze indicates the fierce battle to come.
raw.es: Tu periplo por Morgan comienza en un enorme desierto; el calor abrasador que emana de sus arenas anuncia terribles batallas.
raw.id: Perjalananmu melalu Morgan dimulai di padang pasir besar. Panas yang membara adalah indikasi perang sengit yang akan datang.
raw.pt: Sua jornada por Morgan começa em um deserto gigantesco. A névoa escaldante indica as duras batalhas que virão.
raw.th: การเดินทางของคุณ ผ่านมอร์แกนกำลังเริ่มขึ้นในทะเลทรายขนาดใหญ่ ฝุ่นทรายคละคลุ้งแสดงให้เห็นการต่อสู้ที่รุนแรงกำลังจะมาถึง
raw.vi: Cuộc hành trình của bạn xuyên qua Morgan sẽ bắt đầu từ một vùng sa mạc rộng lớn. Màn sương mù rất nóng là dấu hiệu thể hiện một cuộc chiến đấu thảm khốc sắp xảy ra.

id: Bandit di padang pasir membara ini lebih kuat resolusinya daripada yang di Mistra, dan sepertinya mereka mau memblokir jalanmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_201_DESCRIPTION
desc: The bandits in this burning desert have much stronger resolve that those in Mistral, and it seems they intend to block your way.

raw.en: The bandits in this burning desert have much stronger resolve that those in Mistral, and it seems they intend to block your way.
raw.es: Los bandidos de este desierto tienen mayor determinación que los de Mistral y no piensan dejarte pasar.
raw.id: Bandit di padang pasir membara ini lebih kuat resolusinya daripada yang di Mistra, dan sepertinya mereka mau memblokir jalanmu.
raw.pt: Os bandidos deste deserto flamejante são muito mais determinados do que os de Mistral e parece que eles não vão deixar você passar.
raw.th: โจรในทะเลทรายแผดเผานี้ มีความเข้มแข็งมากกว่าว่าผู้ที่อยู่ในมิสทรัล และดูเหมือนว่าพวกเขาตั้งใจที่จะปิดกั้นทางของคุณ
raw.vi: Các nhóm cướp trong sa mạc nóng bỏng này có sức mạnh lớn hơn các nhóm cướp mà bạn đã gặp ở Mistral, chúng dường như muốn chặn đường đi của bạn.

id: Makhluk yang dipanggil sebagai raja monster mengamuk di padang pasir. Pertempuran yang sengit dengannya tidak terhindarkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_202_DESCRIPTION
desc: A summoned being known as the king of beasts is rampaging in the desert. A fierce battle with him is unavoidable.

raw.en: A summoned being known as the king of beasts is rampaging in the desert. A fierce battle with him is unavoidable.
raw.es: Un ser capaz de dominar a las bestias está sembrando el caos en el desierto. El enfrentamiento es ineludible.
raw.id: Makhluk yang dipanggil sebagai raja monster mengamuk di padang pasir. Pertempuran yang sengit dengannya tidak terhindarkan.
raw.pt: Um ser invocado conhecido como Mestre das Bestas está andando pelo deserto. Uma batalha complicada contra ele é inevitável.
raw.th: สิ่งที่ถูกเรียกมา เป็นที่รู้จักกันในนามราชันย์ของสัตว์ป่าที่อาละวาดอยู่ในทะเลทราย การสู้รบอย่างดุเดือดกับเขาไม่สามารถหลีกเลี่ยงได้
raw.vi: Một vị thần tể của loài thú đang nổi giận trong sa mạc này. Một cuộc chiến đấu thảm khốc với vị thần tể này là điều không thể tránh được.

id: Kamu telah mencapai bagian tengah padang pasir. Inkarnasi kobaran memblokir jalanmu, membakar lebih lanjut tanah di sekitarnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_203_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've reached the desert's mid point. An incarnation of flames blocks the way, further scorching the land around it.

raw.en: You've reached the desert's mid point. An incarnation of flames blocks the way, further scorching the land around it.
raw.es: Has llegado al corazón del desierto. Un espíritu ígneo te impide el paso mientras arrasa el terreno que lo rodea.
raw.id: Kamu telah mencapai bagian tengah padang pasir. Inkarnasi kobaran memblokir jalanmu, membakar lebih lanjut tanah di sekitarnya.
raw.pt: Você chegou à metade do deserto. Uma encarnação de fogo está no caminho, queimando ainda mais o terreno ao redor.
raw.th: คุณได้มาถึงใจกลางทะเลทราย ร่างจุติแห่งเปลวเพลิงกั้นขวางเส้นทาง เพลิงลุกไหม้ไปทั่วบริเวณพื้นรอบๆ
raw.vi: Bạn vừa mới tới chặng giữa của sa mạc. Các đống lửa lớn đang phong tỏa con đường này, hãy dập tắ t chúng!

id: Bagian akhir dari padang pasir sudah terlihat, dan anginnya sekarang berbau laut. Tapi, siluet raksasa memblokir jalanmu…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_204_DESCRIPTION
desc: The end of the desert is in view, and the wind now smells of the sea. However, a giant silhouette stands blocks your path...

raw.en: The end of the desert is in view, and the wind now smells of the sea. However, a giant silhouette stands blocks your path...
raw.es: Por fin avistas el final del desierto, y la brisa te trae aromas marinos. Por desgracia, una imponente silueta se recorta contra el horizonte...
raw.id: Bagian akhir dari padang pasir sudah terlihat, dan anginnya sekarang berbau laut. Tapi, siluet raksasa memblokir jalanmu…
raw.pt: O final do deserto já pode ser visto, e o vento agora traz o cheiro do mar. No entanto, uma figura gigantesca está bloqueando o caminho...
raw.th: มองเห็นช่วงท้ายของทะเลทรายแล้ว และตอนนี้ได้กลิ่นลมทะเลด้วย อย่างไรก็ตามเงายักษ์ก็ยืนขวางเส้นทางของคุณ ...
raw.vi: Chặng cuối của sa mạc này đang hiển hiện trước mặt bạn, một cơn gió mang vị mặn của biển đang thổi vào. Tuy nhiên, có một cái bóng lớn đang đứng ở đó và phong tỏa con đường đi của bạn.

id: Kamu telah mencapai pantai, lolos dari gurun. Pantai tenang, cantik menunggu, tetapi tetap waspada ya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_210_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've reached the shore, escaping the desert. A calm, beautiful beach awaits you, but you must still be cautious.

raw.en: You've reached the shore, escaping the desert. A calm, beautiful beach awaits you, but you must still be cautious.
raw.es: Lograste escapar del desierto y llegaste hasta la costa. Te encuentras con una playa hermosa y tranquila, pero sabes que no puedes confiarte.
raw.id: Kamu telah mencapai pantai, lolos dari gurun. Pantai tenang, cantik menunggu, tetapi tetap waspada ya.
raw.pt: Você chegou no litoral e escapou do deserto. Uma praia belíssima e calma o aguarda, mas ainda é preciso tomar cuidado.
raw.th: คุณได้มาถึงชายฝั่งของทะเลทราย หลบหนีออกจากทะเลทราย ชายหาดที่สวยงามรอคุณ แต่คุณยังคงต้องระมัดระวัง
raw.vi: Bạn đã tiến tới bãi cát biển và sắp thoát khỏi vùng sa mạc đó. Một bãi biển yên bình và tuyệt đẹp đang đợi bạn, nhưng bạn vẫn phải đề phòng!

id: Kapal besar bersauh di pantai. Itu adalah kapal bajak laut, dan sepertinya tidak ada cara mudah untuk melaluinya…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_211_DESCRIPTION
desc: A huge ship is anchored on the beach. It's a pirate ship, and it seems there's no easy way past...

raw.en: A huge ship is anchored on the beach. It's a pirate ship, and it seems there's no easy way past...
raw.es: Hay un enorme barco anclado en la orilla, y en su mástil ondea la bandera pirata. Está claro que no te será fácil avanzar.
raw.id: Kapal besar bersauh di pantai. Itu adalah kapal bajak laut, dan sepertinya tidak ada cara mudah untuk melaluinya…
raw.pt: Um navio enorme está ancorado na praia. É um navio pirata e parece que não há forma fácil de passar por ele...
raw.th: เรือขนาดใหญ่ที่ทอดสมออยู่บนชายหาด มันเป็นเรือโจรสลัดและดูเหมือนว่าไม่มีทางที่จะผ่านไปได้ง่ายๆ ...
raw.vi: một con tàu lớn đang neo trên bãi biển. Nó là tàu cướp biển và không dễ dàng gì qua mắt được chúng.

id: Pemandangan yang indah berlanjut, demikian juga jumlah musuh yang kamu temui. Persiapkan dirimu untuk serangan air.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_212_DESCRIPTION
desc: The beautiful view continues, as do the number of enemies you encounter. Prepare yourself for a water assault.

raw.en: The beautiful view continues, as do the number of enemies you encounter. Prepare yourself for a water assault.
raw.es: El hermoso paisaje continúa hasta donde se pierde la vista... y los enemigos no cesan de presentarse. Prepárate para una lucha en el agua.
raw.id: Pemandangan yang indah berlanjut, demikian juga jumlah musuh yang kamu temui. Persiapkan dirimu untuk serangan air.
raw.pt: A bela vista persiste, assim como a quantidade de inimigos pelo caminho. Se prepare para um ataque aquático.
raw.th: มุมมองที่สวยงามอย่างต่อเนื่อง เช่นเดียวกับจำนวนของศัตรูที่คุณพบ เตรียมตัวสำหรับการโจมตีด้วยธาตุน้ำ
raw.vi: Phong cảnh bãi biển đẹp vẫn tiếp tục cũng giống như bạn sẽ còn đương đầu với nhiều kẻ thù nữa. Hãy chuẩn bị tinh thần để cho cuộc tấn công từ mặt nước.

id: Akhir dari pantai terlihat sekarang. Seorang Roh Air katanya muncul di sekitar sini. Seberapa kuatkah dia?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_213_DESCRIPTION
desc: The end of the coastline is now in view. A Water Spirit is said to appear around here. How strong could it be?

raw.en: The end of the coastline is now in view. A Water Spirit is said to appear around here. How strong could it be?
raw.es: El final de la costa se ve ya en el horizonte. Cuentan que un espíritu acuático se aparece por esta zona, ¿podrás vencerlo?
raw.id: Akhir dari pantai terlihat sekarang. Seorang Roh Air katanya muncul di sekitar sini. Seberapa kuatkah dia?
raw.pt: O fim do litoral já pode ser visto. Dizem que costuma aparecer um espírito da água por essa região. Será que é muito forte?
raw.th: มองเห็นช่วงท้ายของทะเลทรายแล้ว วิญญาณน้ำบอกว่าจะปรากฏรอบๆ ที่นี่ มันจะแข็งแรงสักเท่าไหร่?
raw.vi: Chặng cuối của bờ biển đang hiển hiện trước mắt bạn bây giờ. Một vị thần nước với sức mạnh khủng khiếp sẽ xuất hiện ở đây.

id: Akhirnya kamu mencapai akhir pantai. Hutan yang gelap terlihat di depan, tapi sepertinya ada yang mengendap-endap di dekatnya…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_214_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've finally reached the coast's end. A dark forest is visible ahead, but surely something is lurking near...

raw.en: You've finally reached the coast's end. A dark forest is visible ahead, but surely something is lurking near...
raw.es: Llegaste al final de la costa; ante ti se extiende un bosque oscuro por el que seguro merodean siniestros seres.
raw.id: Akhirnya kamu mencapai akhir pantai. Hutan yang gelap terlihat di depan, tapi sepertinya ada yang mengendap-endap di dekatnya…
raw.pt: Você finalmente chegou ao fim do litoral. Há uma floresta sombria à frente, mas com certeza tem algo à espreita...
raw.th: ในที่คุณได้มาถึงสุดชายฝั่งแล้ว ป่ามืดนั้นอยู่ข้างหน้า แต่แน่นอนว่ามีอะไรบางอย่างซ่อนอยู่บริเวณนั้น...
raw.vi: Cuối cùng bạn cũng đã tiến tới chặng cuối của bờ biển. Một khu rừng đen tối đang hiển lên trước mắt bạn, hãy tìm một nơi nào để ẩn nấp gần đó.

id: Matamu belum menyesuaikan diri dengan kegelapan sejak masuk dari pantai. Apakah Karl dan yang lain baik-baik saja?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_220_DESCRIPTION
desc: Your eyes haven't adjusted to the dark since coming in from the coast. Are Karl and the others OK?

raw.en: Your eyes haven't adjusted to the dark since coming in from the coast. Are Karl and the others OK?
raw.es: Te cuesta acostumbrar la vista a semejante oscuridad tras recorrer la costa bañada por la luz del sol. ¿Estarán bien Karl y los demás?
raw.id: Matamu belum menyesuaikan diri dengan kegelapan sejak masuk dari pantai. Apakah Karl dan yang lain baik-baik saja?
raw.pt: Seus olhos ainda não se adaptaram à escuridão depois de sair da praia. Será que Karl e os outros estão bem?
raw.th: ดวงตาของคุณยังไม่ได้ปรับให้ชินกับความมืด ตั้งแต่เข้ามาจากชายฝั่ง คาร์ลและคนอื่นๆ โอเค?
raw.vi: Hai đôi mắt của bạn vẫn chưa được thích nghi với bóng đêm bởi vì bóng đêm đến từ bờ biển. Karl và những người khác vẫn ổn chứ?

id: Hutan yang gelap seperti ini biasanya penuh bandit. Apakah mereka bekerja lebih baik dalam Gelap? Bagaimanapun, hati-hati.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_221_DESCRIPTION
desc: Dark forests like this are usually full of bandits. Is it that they work better in the Dark? Either way, be careful.

raw.en: Dark forests like this are usually full of bandits. Is it that they work better in the Dark? Either way, be careful.
raw.es: Los lugares como este suelen ser el escondite predilecto de los ladrones, ¿será porque la oscuridad los ampara? Por si acaso, ve con cuidado.
raw.id: Hutan yang gelap seperti ini biasanya penuh bandit. Apakah mereka bekerja lebih baik dalam Gelap? Bagaimanapun, hati-hati.
raw.pt: Florestas sombrias como esta normalmente são cheias de bandidos. Será que eles trabalham melhor no escuro? De qualquer forma, tome cuidado.
raw.th: ป่ามืดเช่นนี้มักจะเต็มไปด้วยโจร พวกเขาทำงานได้ดีขึ้นในความมืดงั้นหรือ? ทางใดก็แล้วแต่ จงระวัง
raw.vi: Các khu rừng bóng đêm đầy rẫy những tên cướp. Chúng chiến đấu tốt hơn khi ở trong bóng đêm. Hãy cẩn thận!

id: Ketidaknyamanan yang kamu rasakan di hutan Mistral kembali, tapi kali ini lebih parah. Apakah ini hasil kerja seorang penyihir waktu?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_222_DESCRIPTION
desc: The discomfort you felt in the forests of Mistral is back, but this time it's worse. Could this be the work of a time mage?

raw.en: The discomfort you felt in the forests of Mistral is back, but this time it's worse. Could this be the work of a time mage?
raw.es: Vuelve a embargarte una sensación de desasosiego como te sucedió en Mistral, solo que peor. ¿Será acaso por culpa de algún cronomago?
raw.id: Ketidaknyamanan yang kamu rasakan di hutan Mistral kembali, tapi kali ini lebih parah. Apakah ini hasil kerja seorang penyihir waktu?
raw.pt: O desconforto que você sentiu na floresta de Mistral voltou, só que agora é pior. Será que é trabalho de um mago do tempo?
raw.th: ความไม่สบายใจที่คุณรู้สึกในป่าแห่งมิสทราลกลับมาอีกครั้ง แต่เวลานี้มันเลวร้ายยิ่งกว่า หรือว่านี่จะเป็นฝีมือของนักล่าแห่งกาลเวลา
raw.vi: Các cảm thấy khó chịu khi ở trong các khu rừng của Mistral đã quay trở lại nhưng lần này còn tệ hại hơn nữa. Đó là do một phù thủy đã tạo ra.

id: Sulit untuk membedakan apakah pohon hanya pohon dan bukan monster yang bersembunyi. Kalau saja kamu bisa melarikan diri dari hutan ini…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_223_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's hard telling which trees are just trees and not just monsters in hiding. If only you could escape this forest...

raw.en: It's hard telling which trees are just trees and not just monsters in hiding. If only you could escape this forest...
raw.es: Cuesta distinguir los árboles de verdad de los monstruos que tras ellos se ocultan. Ojalá pudieras escapar del bosque...
raw.id: Sulit untuk membedakan apakah pohon hanya pohon dan bukan monster yang bersembunyi. Kalau saja kamu bisa melarikan diri dari hutan ini…
raw.pt: É difícil distinguir as formas dessa floresta entre árvores e monstros escondidos. Se você pudesse escapar dessa floresta...
raw.th: มันยากที่จะบอก ว่าต้นไม้เป็นเพียงแค่ต้นไม้ และสัตว์ร้ายไม่เพียงแต่จะซ่อนตัวอยู่ ถ้าเพียงแต่คุณสามารถหลบหนีจากป่านี้ไป...
raw.vi: Thật khó phân biệt cây nào là cây và cây nào là nơi ẩn nấp của những con ma. Bạn hãy thoát ra khỏi khu rừng này.

id: Kegelapan telah menipis. Jalan keluar harusnya dekat, tapi ada aura ketegangan yang kurasa. Pasti ini pertanda adanya musuh yang kuat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_224_DESCRIPTION
desc: The darkness has lightened. The exit should be close, but there's tension in the air. Surely, the sign of a formidable foe.

raw.en: The darkness has lightened. The exit should be close, but there's tension in the air. Surely, the sign of a formidable foe.
raw.es: En la oscuridad se atisba una luz. La salida está cerca, pero la tensión en el ambiente es palpable. Sin duda te aguarda un nuevo y temible enemigo.
raw.id: Kegelapan telah menipis. Jalan keluar harusnya dekat, tapi ada aura ketegangan yang kurasa. Pasti ini pertanda adanya musuh yang kuat.
raw.pt: A escuridão se iluminou. A saída deve estar próxima, mas ainda há tensão no ar. Com certeza é o prenúncio de um inimigo poderoso.
raw.th: ความมืดได้เบาบางลง ทางออกควรจะใกล้แล้ว แต่บรรยากาศกลับตึงเครียด แน่นอนมันเป็นสัญญาณของศัตรูที่น่ากลัว
raw.vi: Bóng đêm đã dần biến mất. Lối thoát đã bị đóng mất và một bầu không khí căng thẳng bao trùm ở đó.  Chắc chắn  đó là hành động của kẻ thù.

id: Setelah melarikan diri dari hutan yang gelap gulita, kamu memasuki tanah kosong yang luas. Area ini dihancurkan oleh guntur.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_230_DESCRIPTION
desc: After escaping the pitch black forest, you entered a vast wasteland. The area is being torn apart by lightning.

raw.en: After escaping the pitch black forest, you entered a vast wasteland. The area is being torn apart by lightning.
raw.es: Tras lograr huir de aquel ominoso bosque llegas a un vasto páramo sobre el que el cielo descarga toda su ira.
raw.id: Setelah melarikan diri dari hutan yang gelap gulita, kamu memasuki tanah kosong yang luas. Area ini dihancurkan oleh guntur.
raw.pt: Depois de escapar da floresta sombria, você entrou em uma vasta terra desolada. A área está sendo destruída por raios.
raw.th: หลังจากหลบหนีออกป่าสีดำ คุณก็ได้เข้าไปสู่ดินแดนรกร้าง พื้นที่จะถูกตัดขาดออกจากกันโดยฟ้าผ่า
raw.vi: Sau khi vượt qua khu rừng đen, bạn bước vào một khu đất hoang vu. Đây là nơi phải chịu đựng tiếng sét dữ dội.

id: Kamu bergerak maju pada saat guntur menghantam semua di sekitarmu. Hati-hati akan serangan udara.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_231_DESCRIPTION
desc: You move forward as lightning strikes down all around you. Beware of incoming aerial attacks.

raw.en: You move forward as lightning strikes down all around you. Beware of incoming aerial attacks.
raw.es: Avanzas mientras los rayos que impactan a tu alrededor hacen sacudir la tierra. Vigila el cielo, quizá te ataquen por aire.
raw.id: Kamu bergerak maju pada saat guntur menghantam semua di sekitarmu. Hati-hati akan serangan udara.
raw.pt: Você avança com raios caindo por todos os lados. Tome cuidado com possíveis ataques aéreos.
raw.th: คุณก้าวไปข้างหน้าในขณะที่ฟ้าผ่าลงมารอบๆ ตัวคุณ ระวังการโจมตีทางอากาศที่กำลังพุ่งมา
raw.vi: Bạn tiến lên phía trước khi các tia sét giáng xuống xung quanh bạn. Hãy cẩn thận với các cuộc tấn công trên không!

id: Kamu hampir mendekati pusat tanah kosong. Apakah Karl dan timnya sukses membunuh setan yang dikejarnya?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_232_DESCRIPTION
desc: You're nearing the center of the wastelands. Did Karl and his team successfully bring down the demon they were chasing?

raw.en: You're nearing the center of the wastelands. Did Karl and his team successfully bring down the demon they were chasing?
raw.es: Te aproximas al centro del páramo. ¿Habrán logrado Karl y su grupo vencer al demonio que estaban persiguiendo?
raw.id: Kamu hampir mendekati pusat tanah kosong. Apakah Karl dan timnya sukses membunuh setan yang dikejarnya?
raw.pt: Você está perto do meio desse deserto. Será que o Karl e a equipe dele conseguiram derrotar o demônio que estavam perseguindo?
raw.th: คุณกำลังเข้าใกล้ศูนย์กลางของดินแดนรกร้าง คาร์ลและทีมของเขาจะประสบความสำเร็จในการจับตัวปีศาจที่พวกเขากำลังไล่ตามรึเปล่า?
raw.vi: Bạn gần như sắp tiến tới khu trung tâm của bãi bỏ hoang đó. Karl và đồng đội của anh ta đã thoát khỏi những cuộc rượt đuổi của bóng ma.

id: Ada kuil yang samar terlihat di kejauhan. Tidak ada tanda-tanda Karl, apa yang telah terjadi padanya…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_233_DESCRIPTION
desc: There's a temple barely visible in the distance. There's no sign of Karl, what has happened to him...

raw.en: There's a temple barely visible in the distance. There's no sign of Karl, what has happened to him...
raw.es: En la distancia vislumbras un templo. No hay ni rastro de Karl, ¿qué habrá sido de él?
raw.id: Ada kuil yang samar terlihat di kejauhan. Tidak ada tanda-tanda Karl, apa yang telah terjadi padanya…
raw.pt: Há um templo que quase não pode ser visto ao longe. Nem sinal do Karl, o que houve com ele?
raw.th: มีวิหารที่สามารถมองเห็นได้ในระยะไกล ไม่มีสัญญาณของคาร์ลเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับเขา...
raw.vi: Có một đền thờ xuất hiện trong không gian. Không có dấu hiệu nào của Karl, chuyện gì đã xảy ra với anh ấy?

id: Raja guntur yang dipanggil memblokir jalanmu di akhir tanah kosong. Kamu harus mengalahkannya sebelum bisa lanjut.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_234_DESCRIPTION
desc: A summoned thunder king is blocking the path at the end of the wasteland. You must defeat him before continuing.

raw.en: A summoned thunder king is blocking the path at the end of the wasteland. You must defeat him before continuing.
raw.es: Un ser que domina el trueno fue invocado para impedirte salir del páramo; no te queda más remedio que derrotarlo.
raw.id: Raja guntur yang dipanggil memblokir jalanmu di akhir tanah kosong. Kamu harus mengalahkannya sebelum bisa lanjut.
raw.pt: Um rei do trovão invocado está no caminho, no final da terra desolada. Você precisa derrotá-lo para continuar.
raw.th: ราชันย์สายฟ้าถูกเรียกมาเพื่อกั้นขวางเส้นทางในส่วนท้ายของดินแดนรกร้าง คุณต้องเอาชนะเขาก่อนที่จะเดินทางไปต่อ
raw.vi: Một vị thần Sấm đang phong tỏa con đường ở chặng cuối của bãi bỏ hoang. Bạn phải đánh bại vị thần Sắm đó trước khi tiếp tục tiến lên!

id: Ada kuil yang bermandikan cahaya. Meskipun telah berumur ribuan tahun, masih terlihat cantik seperti pada hari kuil itu dibangun.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_240_DESCRIPTION
desc: There is a temple bathed in light. Despite it being thousands of years old, it's as beautiful as the day it was built.

raw.en: There is a temple bathed in light. Despite it being thousands of years old, it's as beautiful as the day it was built.
raw.es: La luz baña el templo que ante ti se alza. Conserva su imponente belleza a pesar de tener cientos de años de antigüedad.
raw.id: Ada kuil yang bermandikan cahaya. Meskipun telah berumur ribuan tahun, masih terlihat cantik seperti pada hari kuil itu dibangun.
raw.pt: Há um templo banhado pela luz. Apesar de ter milhares de anos, ainda preserva a mesma beleza de quando foi erguido.
raw.th: มีวิหารที่อาบไล้ด้วยแสง แม้ว่าอยู่มาเป็นพันๆ ปีแล้วก็ตาม มันยังคงดูสวยงามเหมือนวันที่มันถูกสร้างขึ้น
raw.vi: Có một đền thờ tràn ngập ánh sáng. Mặc dù nó đã được hàng nghìn năm tuổi nhưng nó vẫn đẹp như thời mới được xây dựng.

id: Kamu lanjut berjalan masuk ke dalam kuil yang besar. Kamu bisa melihat siluet yang tenang dari pegasus yang berdiri di sekitarnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_241_DESCRIPTION
desc: You continue even deeper into the massive temple. You can make out the solemn silhouettes of pegasi standing about.

raw.en: You continue even deeper into the massive temple. You can make out the solemn silhouettes of pegasi standing about.
